current.text: Charlotte got him from Phoenix in the Miles Bridges trade, together with Grayson Allen.
He is a bench player in Charlotte, in a small role. The projected bench is Allen, Schröder, Steinbach, O'Neale and Grant Williams.
He may pick up more power forward minutes, but the expert says he is not worth drafting.

durable.text: His best categories are threes and low turnovers. His weakest are points and FG%. None of them is a league outlier.
He has shown signs of decline, and teams around the league saw him as a negative asset.

note: Do not draft him. Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD and rank him 216 and 155, while our auction only fills 144 roster spots. If you need threes, he is a low-turnover option on waivers (about 2.3 threes and 1.1 TO projected), but his 8.4 points and 41.8 FG% give little else. Early in the season, check whether his power forward minutes grow beyond his bench role.
